openBlockers.detail: Exact ordered v1.83 C01-C48 LIVE enumeration is still unrecovered. Nine of the ten historical v1.81 decompression splits are semantically recovered; exactly one remains unresolved: a Canon boundary.
Low and Solemn bell/cinematic cue ownership is not yet independently certified. R18 fails these transient channels closed instead of borrowing Missa Cantata or legacy state.

Low/Solemn post-Mass and lifecycle composition is not yet modularly certified. Low-Mass Leonine-prayer applicability/branch ownership must be recovered as an explicit lifecycle contract rather than inferred inside the reader.

Special-structure plan projection is certified. Asperges has native payload plus modular runtime switching. Palm Sunday now has a source-pinned native payload and corrected Introit/Last-Gospel plan handoff; Palm runtime switching plus remaining rites are still pending.
Real-browser phone-width/touch acceptance for focus, first/last cue ownership, Back/Next, translations and card transitions has not yet been recreated for R17.

MC-COM-150 and MC-COM-160 are now independently suppressible and Pax Domini remains distinct, but MC-COM-160 still carries B/C_PENDING evidence. Accepted source authority and reader ownership for the Solemn ministerial Pax transfer must be pinned before release certification.
